data.narrative:
Wyvern is a Series A-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised $16M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B Series B, Aalyria at $1.3B Series B, and Starcloud at $1.1B Seed).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $16M total raised proxy, implying a $32M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the three private comparables yields a $1.3B median valuation, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue figures.

The two applicable methods produce a wide triangulated range from $27M (low bound anchored to stage-progression) to $1.5B (high bound anchored to peer maximum), with a median of $666M. The substantial spread reflects the significant early-stage uncertainty inherent in Series A positioning and the wide dispersion of peer valuations across Seed and Series B stages. Revenue generation capacity and path to profitability remain key uncertainties not resolved by this comp-based analysis.
